title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE TABLETS safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE TABLETS. ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE tablets, for oral use C IV Initial U.S. Approval: 1992.

sections.boxed_warning: Zolpidem tartrate 5 mg tablets, USP are red colored, capsule shaped tablets with the Torrent logo debossed on one side and '5 MG' debossed on the other side and supplied as: Cartons of 100 tablets (10 tablets each blister pack x 10), NDC 0904-6082-61 WARNING: This Unit Dose package is not child resistant and is Intended for Institutional Use Only. Keep this and all drugs out of the reach of children. Store at 20º to 25°C (68º to 77°F); excursions permitted to 15° to 30°C (59º to 86°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature].
